title: pragma - a grand strategy where nations are LLMs
author: SereneKoala
selftext:
the past year, we've been developing pragma, a grand strategy where nations are LLM's. as the leader of your nation, you can write policy that has has in-game effects on both domestically and internationally. not every policy is guaranteed to work, and that some policies you write might actually hinder your situation. every nation has demographics, race, religion, political groups, and all of these things can be influenced by your policy. you can also declare war on other nations, recruit troops, and invade countries. every (public) thing you do is reflected in the world newspaper, where every nation reads. every nation has their own hidden motive that we call tracks, and those tracks can be sidelined or swayed through direct leader diplomacy or your own crazy policy.

we've spent the past year optimizing the nation LLM's to the point where they're both smarter and cheaper. there can always be room for improvement, but we're finally at a state we want to let playtesters in. we just published a blog on the state of the game a year into development: [https://playpragma.com/blog/one-year-of-pragma](https://playpragma.com/blog/one-year-of-pragma)

some questions for testers (the game is open ended, use all your tokens!):

1. we worked hard on getting LLM costs cheap while also making narratives fun. does the current LLM system achieve that for you?
2. one of the most difficult things is feedback loops and goals. every nation has stat modifiers, political power, stability, innovation, war support, and money. how well do you think you are able to acheive your goals and is it apparent that your in game interactions mean something?

the game is gated for now, but you can sign up and use **aigamedev1023** to get 1500 credits, which is around 7 in-game years of playtime. you can’t buy credits yet, so go ahead and use up our tokens for free for now. the code lasts until oct 23 at 11:59 pm PST.

you can also submit feedback directly on the site. found something broken or thought of something great? send it our way and we’ll give you some credits theres a ton more stuff we want to add, and hope you all can try out this early alpha.

PS: join our discord for updates, and sometimes we'll give out free credits! [https://playpragma.com/](https://playpragma.com/)
